comment: OpenCiv2's own assets (docs/NO-INSTALL.md, Music; docs/HD-GRAPHICS.md, Your own heralds): the source of data/native/music and data/native/heralds (made by make own-assets, not in the repository), OpenCiv2's own repository openciv2/openciv2-assets (repo; MIT, as OpenCiv2: its LICENSE; not Peter Johnson's PeterJohnson/openciv2-assets, the HD art's, data/hd-pack.json) at this commit (sha), each file checked against its SHA-256 and size here. tools/build_own_assets.py fetches them (the files at the commit, from raw.githubusercontent.com) into ~/.cache/openciv2; music: CD track number -> the track, Ogg Opus, made Ogg Vorbis (stb_vorbis, which plays the music, has no Opus decoder) as data/native/music/trackNN.ogg, which the game plays as CD track NN where its folder has no Music\TrackNN (src/platform/sound.c; the repository's 01 - Dorian Pastoral is not used: no CD track, not yet chosen); heralds: the diplomacy room's animated heralds, copied as they are into data/native/heralds (heralds.txt and the WebPs it names; src/platform/hd.c: hd_herald_find; the local data/native/hd-extra's heralds.txt, where it has the tribe, wins); notices: beside both. Upgrading: sha and the files' sha256 and size here (git ls-remote REPO main), then the tool.
